Claim 1 (Currently Amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, wherein the station includes a timer that measures a predetermined acknowledgment interval, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of the timer, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor that is perceptually distinct from the first alarm.

Claim 16 (Currently Amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition and to track acknowledgment status of the alarm; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, and an acknowledgment status indicator; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data, wherein the system is configured to escalate the alarm if the acknowledgment status indicates the alarm remains unacknowledged after a predetermined time interval.

Claim 17 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system.

Claim 18 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm and is updated in real-time as the alarm escalation status changes.

Claim 19 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm, including a timestamp of when the acknowledgement was received.

Claim 20 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices only when the alarm remains unacknowledged after the predetermined time interval.
